subject: PoC path recommendation & next steps — Hosted / Dedicated / Private for MedFin
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rowe <alex.rowe@medfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: PoC path recommendation & next steps — Hosted / Dedicated / Private for MedFin

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC plan and timeline.

Recap from call:
- Primary constraint: PHI + EU data residency requirement; audit logs + 12mo retention mandatory.
- Performance target: p95 latency <100ms, throughput ~5k requests/day during peak.
- Integrations required: SSO (SAML), KMS for key separation, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

High-level recommendation (to align options):
- Preferred for long-term: Private (VPC / on-prem) — meets PHI & KMS requirements but ~6–8 week onboarding.
- Fast path to evaluate: Dedicated reserved capacity — can stand up a bounded PoC in ~2 weeks, supports KMS and private networking peering, then transition to Private for production.
- Hosted API: feasible only for limited, non-PHI evals; not recommended for production given residency/SLA needs.

Proposed PoC plan (recommendation):
1) Short initial Dedicated PoC (2 weeks) to validate latency, request patterns, and integrations (SSO + KMS test keys).
2) Parallel work on Private deployment checklist (networking, compliance signoffs) with a target production migration in 6–8 weeks if procurement/infra approvals go smoothly.

Please confirm:
- Is MedFin comfortable with starting on Dedicated as a time-to-value compromise?
- Who is the internal owner on your side for SSO / network (name + best contact)?
- Confirm success criteria: I captured latency / throughput / audit log retention above — anything to add?

I attached a short security overview and the SLA footprint for reference. If that approach works I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff with our infra lead (Marcus) and Soojin (customer engineering) next week.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (see summary)

From: Alex Rowe <alex.rowe@medfin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@medfin.com>, Julie Park <julie.park@medfin.com>, Omar Rizvi <omar.rizvi@medfin.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: PoC path recommendation & next steps — Hosted / Dedicated / Private for MedFin

Thanks Priya — helpful recap. Quick answers from our side:

1) Deployment preference: Private VPC for production given PHI and EU residency. Procurement will not sign off on Hosted.
2) Timeline sensitivity: Legal/procurement wants a working PoC to evaluate before end of Q2. If Private takes 6–8 weeks, we’d prefer a faster evaluation first (Dedicated PoC) assuming it can demonstrate the SLOs and integration surface.
3) Success criteria (please include these in the PoC acceptance):
   - Latency: p95 < 100ms for typical 512-token prompts
   - Throughput: sustained 5k requests/day with bursts to 10k/day
   - Data residency: all inference logs stored in EU region (and exported logs are anonymized unless explicitly approved)
   - Security: SAML SSO onboarding, KMS integration for key control, audit log retention 12 months

Stakeholders:
- Sarah Lin, CTO (technical signoff)
- Julie Park, Procurement (contracts / PO)
- Omar Rizvi, Head of Security (controls / SOC2 check)

We’ve attached a short spreadsheet with our security / compliance asks. We’re fine starting with a Dedicated PoC as long as Redwood can demonstrate the KMS flow and show how we’d transition to Private without a full data migration.

Available next week for the kickoff: Tue 26 May or Thu 28 May (EU morning).

Alex
Alex Rowe
Head of Platform, MedFin Health
alex.rowe@medfin.com

Attachment: MedFin_security_requirements.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:58:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PoC path recommendation & next steps — Hosted / Dedicated / Private for MedFin

+1 to the Dedicated-first approach for the PoC. Notes from an infra perspective and a rough plan: 

What we can stand up quickly:
- Dedicated reserved pool: pre-configured GPU nodes + network peering. Estimated provisioning time: ~7–10 business days.
- KMS: we can accept customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) for the Dedicated PoC; we need the KMS contact and an initial test key.
- SSO: SAML config is straightforward — expect 1–2 business days once we have IdP metadata.

PoC tasks and owners (proposed):
- Redwood infra/setup: Marcus Lin (infra lead) — provisioning + performance tuning (action: provide dedicated-estimate.xlsx).
- Customer SSO/KMS kickoff: Priya to collect IdP metadata and KMS test key.
- Security review: Soojin to share SOC2 artifacts and audit log export options.

Timeline (accelerated):
- Day 0: kickoff + exchange IdP/KMS metadata
- Day 3–7: provision Dedicated pool + basic integration
- Day 8–14: load/latency tests, run our sample prompt suite, verify p95 targets, and deliver short PoC report

If the customer confirms Dedicated PoC, I’ll generate a slim estimate and a short SOW (2–3 pages) so procurement has something to review. I attached the preliminary estimate to this thread.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachment: dedicated-estimate.xlsx

Subject: Re: PoC path recommendation & next steps — Hosted / Dedicated / Private for MedFin

Alex — thanks, that all sounds aligned. Final proposal from our side:

1) Kickoff: Tue 26 May 2026 at 09:30 CET / 00:30 PDT — 30 minutes to exchange IdP metadata, KMS test key, and confirm network contacts.
2) Start Dedicated PoC immediately after kickoff (7–14 day window as Marcus outlined). Our objective will be to validate latency p95 <100ms and integration flows.
3) In parallel we’ll run the Private onboarding checklist so transition timelines (6–8 weeks) are realistic if you decide to move to production on Private.

Deliverables by end of PoC:
- PoC report with latency/throughput graphs and recommendations
- Integration verification checklist (SSO, KMS)
- Short SOW for Dedicated → Private transition and cost outline for procurement

I’ve added a HubSpot link to the deal and a shared Drive folder for artifacts. Please confirm the kickoff slot (Tue 26 or Thu 28) and I’ll send the calendar invite + Zoom.

Regards,
Priya
